type gateChecker struct {
	matches func(context.Context, string, gateway.ProcessIdentity) (bool, error)
}

func (checker gateChecker) Matches(ctx context.Context, role string, sid int32, incarnation string) (bool, error) {
	return checker.matches(ctx, role, gateway.ProcessIdentity{ServerID: sid, Incarnation: incarnation})
}

type gateProjection struct {
	mu           sync.Mutex
	records      map[coredata.TransactionID]coredata.CommitRecord
	target       dataengine.ProjectionStore
	calls        atomic.Uint64
	projectNS    atomic.Uint64
	maxProjectNS atomic.Uint64
	batchCalls   atomic.Uint64
	batchRecords atomic.Uint64
}

func (store *gateProjection) Project(ctx context.Context, record coredata.CommitRecord) error {
	if store.target != nil {
		started := time.Now()
		err := store.target.Project(ctx, record)
		ns := uint64(time.Since(started))
		store.calls.Add(1)
		store.projectNS.Add(ns)
		for old := store.maxProjectNS.Load(); ns > old && !store.maxProjectNS.CompareAndSwap(old, ns); old = store.maxProjectNS.Load() {
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	store.records[record.ID] = coredata.CloneCommitRecord(record)
	return nil
}

// 记录器只在目标明确承诺批量幂等时暴露该能力，不能让测试包装改变正式投影路径。
type gateBatchProjection struct {
	*gateProjection
	batch dataengine.BatchProjectionStore
}

func (store *gateBatchProjection) ProjectBatch(ctx context.Context, records []coredata.CommitRecord) error {
	started := time.Now()
	err := store.batch.ProjectBatch(ctx, records)
	ns := uint64(time.Since(started))
	store.batchCalls.Add(1)
	store.batchRecords.Add(uint64(len(records)))
	store.projectNS.Add(ns)
	for old := store.maxProjectNS.Load(); ns > old && !store.maxProjectNS.CompareAndSwap(old, ns); old = store.maxProjectNS.Load() {
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	for _, record := range records {
		store.records[record.ID] = coredata.CloneCommitRecord(record)
	}
	return nil
}
func (store *gateBatchProjection) SupportsParallelProjection() bool {
	target, ok := store.batch.(dataengine.ParallelProjectionStore)
	return ok && target.SupportsParallelProjection()
}
func (store *gateBatchProjection) SupportsRemoteParallelProjection() bool {
	target, ok := store.batch.(dataengine.RemoteParallelProjectionStore)
	return ok && target.SupportsRemoteParallelProjection()
}
func (store *gateProjection) projectionStore() dataengine.ProjectionStore {
	if batch, ok := store.target.(dataengine.BatchProjectionStore); ok {
		return &gateBatchProjection{gateProjection: store, batch: batch}
	}
	return store
}

type gateBatchProbe struct {
	fail    bool
	batches int
}

func (probe *gateBatchProbe) Project(context.Context, coredata.CommitRecord) error { return nil }
func (probe *gateBatchProbe) ProjectBatch(context.Context, []coredata.CommitRecord) error {
	probe.batches++
	if probe.fail {
		return fmt.Errorf("injected batch failure")
	}
	return nil
}
func (probe *gateBatchProbe) SupportsParallelProjection() bool { return true }
func TestGeneratedGateProjectionCapabilities(t *testing.T) {
	store := &gateProjection{records: make(map[coredata.TransactionID]coredata.CommitRecord)}
	if _, ok := store.projectionStore().(dataengine.BatchProjectionStore); ok {
		t.Fatal("invented batch capability")
	}
	probe := &gateBatchProbe{fail: true}
	store.target = probe
	wrapped, ok := store.projectionStore().(dataengine.ParallelProjectionStore)
	if !ok || !wrapped.SupportsParallelProjection() {
		t.Fatal("lost batch/parallel capability")
	}
	records := []coredata.CommitRecord{{ID: coredata.TransactionID{1}}, {ID: coredata.TransactionID{2}}}
	if err := wrapped.ProjectBatch(context.Background(), records); err == nil || len(store.records) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("failed batch recorded as success")
	}
	probe.fail = false
	if err := wrapped.ProjectBatch(context.Background(), records); err != nil || len(store.records) != 2 || probe.batches != 2 {
		t.Fatal("batch not forwarded or recorded")
	}
}
func (store *gateProjection) diagnostics() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{"single_calls": store.calls.Load(), "batch_calls": store.batchCalls.Load(), "batch_records": store.batchRecords.Load(), "store_total_ms": float64(store.projectNS.Load()) / 1e6, "store_max_ms": float64(store.maxProjectNS.Load()) / 1e6}
}
func TestGeneratedGateNestDAOAndWAL(t *testing.T) {
	url := os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_NATS_URL")
	if url == "" {
		t.Skip("private NATS URL not configured")
	}
	real := newRealGateFixture(t)
	identityID := int64(7001)
	ticket := "ticket"
	if real != nil {
		identityID = real.playerID
		ticket = real.ticket
	}
	player, world := newScenePlayer(t, identityID), newSceneWorld(t)
	handler.RegisterAddExpNestHandlers()
	t.Cleanup(nest.ResetHandlersForTest)
	walDir := t.TempDir()
	wal, err := nestwal.Open(nestwal.DefaultOptions(walDir))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store := &gateProjection{records: make(map[coredata.TransactionID]coredata.CommitRecord)}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		t.Logf("projection diagnostic: %+v", store.diagnostics())
	})
	if real != nil {
		store.target = real.store
	}
	projector, err := dataengine.NewProjector(wal, store.projectionStore(), dataengine.DefaultProjectorOptions())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := projector.Close(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	syncTransport := &gatewiring.Transport{SyncMessageID: 501, LockstepMessageID: 502}
	syncManager, err := entitysync.NewManager(entitysync.ManagerConfig{Mode: entitysync.ModeOnChange, Interval: time.Hour, Transport: syncTransport})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = syncManager.Register(player.Sync()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = syncManager.Close(context.Background()) })
	business := nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithEntitySync(syncManager), nest.NestOptionWithGetter(sceneGetter{player.ID(): player, world.ID(): world}), nest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(projector), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 8, QueueCap: 65536}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}))
	if err := business.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = business.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
	registry := playeraccess.NewProtocolRegistry()
	if err := playeraccess.RegisterProtocol[*pb.AddExpRequest, *pb.AddExpResponse](registry, msgid.MsgAddExp, msgid.MsgAddExp, pb.UnmarshalAddExpRequest, pb.MarshalAddExpResponse, func(ctx *playeraccess.Context, request *pb.AddExpRequest) (*pb.AddExpResponse, error) {
		if ctx.PlayerID != identityID {
			return nil, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
		gained, err := syncsender.NewAddExpSender(business).MultiSync_AddExp(ctx.Context(), player.ID(), world.ID(), request.Amount)
		return &pb.AddExpResponse{LevelsGained: gained}, err
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := registry.Seal(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	config := gateway.DefaultConfig()
	config.Namespace = fmt.Sprintf("roost.generated.gate.n%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
	gateID, gameID := gateway.ProcessIdentity{ServerID: 11, Incarnation: "gate000000000001"}, gateway.ProcessIdentity{ServerID: 22, Incarnation: "game000000000001"}
	raw := func(role string, identity gateway.ProcessIdentity) fnats.RawClient {
		client, err := driver.NewClient(fnats.DefaultConfig(url), driver.ClientOptions{ReconnectBufferBytes: -1})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Cleanup(client.Close)
		prefix, _ := gateway.InboxPrefix(config.Namespace, role, identity)
		scoped, err := client.ForInbox(prefix)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return scoped
	}
	gameRaw, gateRaw := raw("game", gameID), raw("gate", gateID)
	var activeSession atomic.Uint64
	var auth gateway.Authenticator = gateway.AuthenticatorFunc(func(_ context.Context, ticket string, _ net.Addr) (gateway.Principal, error) {
		if ticket != "ticket" {
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
		return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: 7001, ServerID: 22, SessionID: "generated"}, nil
	})
	if real != nil {
		auth = real.auth
	}
	matches := func(_ context.Context, role string, id gateway.ProcessIdentity) (bool, error) {
		return (role == "game" && id == gameID) || (role == "gate" && id == gateID), nil
	}
	cfg := viper.New()
	cfg.Set("player.tcp.enabled", false)
	capabilities := app.NewRegistry(cfg)
	for _, capability := range []app.Capability{{Name: app.ModSingletonIncarnation, Value: app.SingletonIncarnation{Sid: gameID.ServerID, Token: gameID.Incarnation}}, {Name: app.ModSingletonIdentityChecker, Value: gateChecker{matches}}, {Name: mods.ModNatsRaw, Value: gameRaw}, {Name: accessplayer.Name, Value: &accessplayer.Runtime{Protocols: registry}}} {
		if err := capabilities.Register(capability.Name, capability.Value); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	options := gatewiring.DefaultOptions()
	options.Config = config
	options.Authenticator = auth
	options.Ready = func() bool { return true }
	options.OnActive = func(binding gateway.Binding, id uint64) error {
		activeSession.Store(id)
		if err := syncManager.OpenSession(entitysync.SessionID(id)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return syncManager.Subscribe(entitysync.SessionID(id), player.ID(), entity.SyncProfile{})
	}
	options.OnClosed = func(_ gateway.Binding, id uint64) { syncManager.CloseSession(entitysync.SessionID(id)) }
	ingressMod := playertcp.NewIngressMod(options)
	if err := ingressMod.Init(cfg); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := ingressMod.Provide(capabilities); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ingress, ok := app.Lookup[*gateway.GameIngress](capabilities, gatewiring.GameIngressName)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("generated Game ingress not provided")
	}
	if _, ok := app.Lookup[*playertcp.Runtime](capabilities, playertcp.Name); !ok {
		t.Fatal("generated business runtime missing")
	}

	syncTransport.Game = ingress
	if err = syncManager.Start(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = ingressMod.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gate, err := gateway.NewGate(config, gateID, gateway.GateDependencies{Client: gateRaw, QueueFactory: gatewiring.AsyncQueueFactory, Ready: func() bool { return true }, Matches: matches, ResolveGame: func(context.Context, int32) (gateway.ProcessIdentity, error) { return gameID, nil }})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = gate.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tcp := gateway.DefaultTCPConfig()
	tcp.Addr = "127.0.0.1:0"
	tcp.MaxPayloadBytes = uint32(config.MaxPayloadBytes)
	server, err := gateway.NewTCPServer(tcp, gate.Forward, auth)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = server.ConnectHandshake(gate); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	for _, client := range []fnats.RawClient{gameRaw, gateRaw} {
		if err := client.FlushContext(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err = server.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := gate.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		if err := server.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		if err := ingressMod.StopWithContext(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	if os.Getenv("ROOST_GATE_LOAD_SECONDS") != "" {
		if real == nil {
			t.Fatal("load requires real account and storage")
		}
		runGateLoad(t, server.Addr().String(), ticket, player, world, business, syncManager, &activeSession, projector, wal, store, real, walDir)
		return
	}
	if executable := os.Getenv("ROOST_GATE_DOTNET_DLL"); executable != "" || os.Getenv("ROOST_GATE_NATIVE_EXE") != "" {
		childCtx, stop := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer stop()
		command := exec.CommandContext(childCtx, "dotnet", executable, fmt.Sprint(server.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port))
		if native := os.Getenv("ROOST_GATE_NATIVE_EXE"); native != "" {
			command = exec.CommandContext(childCtx, native, fmt.Sprint(server.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port), fmt.Sprint(msgid.MsgAddExp))
		}
		command.Env = append(os.Environ(), "ROOST_GATE_TICKET="+ticket)
		stdout, err := command.StdoutPipe()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var stderr strings.Builder
		command.Stderr = &stderr
		if err = command.Start(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(stdout)
		var removalErr error
		passed := false
		for scanner.Scan() {
			line := scanner.Text()
			t.Log(line)
			if line == "READY_REMOVE" {
				removalErr = syncManager.Unsubscribe(entitysync.SessionID(activeSession.Load()), player.ID())
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "PASS C# Gate/") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "PASS C++ Gate/") {
				passed = true
			}
		}
		waitErr := command.Wait()
		if scanner.Err() != nil || waitErr != nil || removalErr != nil || !passed {
			t.Fatalf("C# chain: scan=%v process=%v remove=%v passed=%v stderr=%s", scanner.Err(), waitErr, removalErr, passed, stderr.String())
		}
	} else {
		conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", server.Addr().String(), time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer conn.Close()
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
		if err = wire.Write(conn, []*wire.Packet{{Seq: 1, Payload: []byte(ticket)}}, 8192); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err = wire.Read(conn, 8192); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// Interval 为一小时，下面的增量必须由 handler 完成后的 on_change 唤醒。
		snapshot, err := wire.Read(conn, config.MaxPayloadBytes)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if (wire.Header{Flags: snapshot.Flags}).Kind() != wire.PayloadSync || snapshot.MsgID != 501 {
			t.Fatalf("initial Sync packet=%+v", snapshot)
		}
		full, err := entitysync.DecodeFrame(snapshot.Payload, frame.DefaultLimits())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(full.Objects) != 1 || len(full.Objects[0].Components) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("snapshot=%+v", full)
		}
		initial, err := entitysync.DecodeSubjectUpdate(full.Objects[0].Components[0].Data, 0)
		if err != nil || !initial.Full || initial.SubjectID != player.ID() {
			t.Fatalf("initial update=%+v error=%v", initial, err)
		}
		data, err := pb.MarshalAddExpRequest(&pb.AddExpRequest{Amount: 250})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = wire.Write(conn, []*wire.Packet{{MsgID: msgid.MsgAddExp, Seq: 2, Payload: data}}, config.MaxPayloadBytes); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var gotResponse, gotDelta bool
		for range 2 {
			response, err := wire.Read(conn, config.MaxPayloadBytes)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if (wire.Header{Flags: response.Flags}).Kind() == wire.PayloadSync {
				delta, err := entitysync.DecodeFrame(response.Payload, frame.DefaultLimits())
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if delta.Epoch != full.Epoch || delta.Tick <= full.Tick || len(delta.Objects) != 1 || len(delta.Objects[0].Components) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("delta frame=%+v", delta)
				}
				update, err := entitysync.DecodeSubjectUpdate(delta.Objects[0].Components[0].Data, 0)
				if err != nil || update.Full || update.SubjectID != player.ID() || update.BaseVersion != initial.Version || update.Version <= initial.Version || update.Payload.Len() == 0 {
					t.Fatalf("delta=%+v err=%v", update, err)
				}
				gotDelta = true
			} else {
				decoded, err := pb.UnmarshalAddExpResponse(response.Payload)
				if err != nil || decoded.Code != 0 || decoded.LevelsGained == 0 || response.MsgID != msgid.MsgAddExp || response.Seq != 2 {
					t.Fatalf("response=%+v packet=%+v err=%v", decoded, response, err)
				}
				gotResponse = true
			}
		}
		if !gotResponse || !gotDelta {
			t.Fatalf("response=%v delta=%v", gotResponse, gotDelta)
		}
	}
	flushCtx, flushCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer flushCancel()
	if err = projector.Flush(flushCtx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store.mu.Lock()
	records := make([]coredata.CommitRecord, 0, len(store.records))
	for _, record := range store.records {
		records = append(records, record)
	}
	store.mu.Unlock()
	if len(records) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unique transactions=%d", len(records))
	}
	for _, record := range records {
		ids := make(map[int64]bool)
		for _, mutation := range record.Mutations {
			ids[mutation.Key.ID] = true
		}
		if len(ids) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("two-entity transaction=%+v", record)
		}
	}
	if stats := wal.Stats(); stats.Appended != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("WAL=%+v", stats)
	}
	if real != nil {
		if err := business.Shutdown(flushCtx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := projector.Close(flushCtx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		real.verifyRecovery(t, walDir, records[0], player, world)
	}
}
